data.name: Tyrannical Strike
data.description: At 8th level, as an immediate action upon successfully hitting an opponent with a melee attack, you can choose to forgo the damage (but not any other effects of the attack) to instead affect the creature you hit as a greater command spell, with a caster level equal of %1. You can use this ability %2 times per day.|DomainLawLVL|DomainLawLVL/4-1
